result.quote: Then the old prophet instructed his sons, “Saddle the donkey for me.” So they saddled it,
result.reason: The window never says that the old prophet heard any men, so the question’s time reference is unsupported. It also says his sons saddled the donkey, not that he did so himself. Several later actions are possible answers: he instructs his sons, goes and finds the body, retrieves it, mourns, and buries it. Thus the key is neither fully accurate nor uniquely determined by the wording.
